The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-fifth and final season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S25|Pokémon Ultimate Journeys]], in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==The Complete Collection== [[File:Pokemon_ultimate_journeys_the_Complete_season.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon Ultimate Journeys - The Complete Season]] Pokémon Ultimate Journeys - The Complete Season was released on July 23, 2024, by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. This [[Complete Collection]] contains six discs with 54 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000097935. Optional English closed captioning is included. Clean versions of the opening and ending themes are included as a special feature. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Galar}}; border: 2px solid #{{colorschemedark|Galar}}" !
